name: Leo Strauss
shortBio: German-American political philosopher who revitalized classical political rationalism against modern historicism and positivism, unearthing the art of esoteric writing and illuminating the perpetual tension between Athens (reason) and Jerusalem (revelation).
centralQuestion: Can classical political rationalism rescue Western civilization from the relativistic crisis of modernity and the nihilistic loss of natural right?

keyWorks.title: Persecution and the Art of Writing
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking hermeneutic study demonstrating that pre-modern philosophical masters wrote with exoteric surface teachings for the public and esoteric messages between the lines for philosophical readers.

keyWorks.title: Natural Right and History
keyWorks.description: Masterwork tracing the intellectual trajectory from classical teleological natural right (Plato, Aristotle) to the modern crisis of relativism initiated by Machiavelli, Hobbes, and Weber.

keyWorks.title: Thoughts on Machiavelli
keyWorks.description: Controversial and meticulous reading identifying Machiavelli as the conscious initiator of the modern break with classical moral teleology and virtue.

keyWorks.title: The City and Man
keyWorks.description: Profound close readings of Aristotle's Politics, Plato's Republic, and Thucydides' Peloponnesian War reconstructing classical civic and philosophical horizons.
